status: source-only candidate; not compared with archive or application
independence: Only source PDF rasters were inspected during this task. WSPRadar outputs and numerical fixtures were not opened. Prior-task exposure to results prevents any claim of complete blinding.
paper_meaning: Figure 3 blue markers are daily soil moisture on the right axis. Figure 4 blue diamonds denote April 1-15 SNR differences averaged over a day, plotted against soil moisture. Figure 4 blue values are therefore external daily-average evidence, not the Figure 3 soil-moisture series or a curve fitted to WSPRadar.

figure3.date_indexing: Assign the successive daily blue markers to April 1 through April 15 using their x positions relative to the printed date ticks; do not infer a precise soil-measurement timestamp.

uncertainty.method: For isolated symmetric markers, use a colour-segment centroid rather than the marker edge. A conservative +/-2 pixels allows antialias/compression/segmentation asymmetry. Add +/-1 pixel for locating each axis endpoint. Report corner-extreme calibration intervals. Marker radius is not a statistical error bar. Do not assign this narrow bound to merged or line-occluded diamonds.
uncertainty.scope: Raster readout and axis calibration only; no allowance for archive-population or scientific-method differences.

matching_rule: A Figure 4 isolated marker is uniquely dated only if its calibrated moisture interval overlaps exactly one of the 15 Figure 3 daily-moisture intervals. No nearest-neighbour assignment or sorting by assumed monotonic soil drying is allowed. Dates are not inferred from WSPRadar values.

date_independent_first_half_extrema.population: Blue April 1-15 Figure 4 diamonds only; red April 16-30 markers excluded
date_independent_first_half_extrema.reason: The vertically highest and lowest blue markers are isolated and clearly separated from every other blue marker. No date assignment, reconstruction of merged diamonds or fitted trend line is needed.

ambiguities.reason: Figure 3 soil-moisture centroids differ by only about 1.6 pixels or less, within the conservative matching uncertainty; three Figure 4 low-SNR points cannot be uniquely assigned to these individual days.
Figure 3 moisture centroids are effectively coincident. Their Figure 4 diamonds are overlapping near 21.5 percent moisture; individual date assignment is unsupported.

Several other Figure 4 diamonds are close, merged or crossed by the fitted line, so generic colour-component centroids are biased and cannot support the isolated-marker uncertainty bound. They have not been assigned.

recommendation: Use the blue-group minimum and maximum as the simplest external daily-average scale anchors. The three uniquely moisture-matched isolated dates provide optional additional external checks. Defer any exact 15-day point-by-date series or sorted-15-value fixture until merged diamonds are reliably resolved or author data are obtained. A mismatch must be reported as a reproduction discrepancy; do not widen these pixel-derived bounds to absorb an uninvestigated population difference.
limits: The paper describes daily averages but does not supply original SQL, duplicate policy or detailed weighting formula.
Figure 4 does not explicitly specify exact daily cutoff timestamps; date labels alone do not prove a UTC daily-boundary contract.
The regression line -0.81*moisture+24 and rounded R2=0.95 are not replacements for actual observed daily means.
This file does not evaluate application correctness and contains no application-derived expectations.
